CheckTitle: Ensure access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks that active IAM user access keys are no older than 90 days.
Risk: Long-lived keys accumulate exposure in code, logs, laptops and CI systems; rotation limits the useful lifetime of a leaked key.

Code.CLI: aws iam create-access-key --user-name <user> && aws iam update-access-key --user-name <user> --access-key-id <old> --status Inactive

Recommendation.Text: Rotate access keys at least every 90 days, or better, replace long-term keys with IAM roles and short-lived credentials.
